newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE GRAINS UP AS STERLING FALLS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE GRAINS UP AS STERLING FALLS.

text.p: LIFFE grains rose on Wednesday, pushed higher by a weaker sterling, traders said.
"It broke ranks with sterling yesterday, but today it's back in line," one trader said.
Active November wheat last traded 1.30 stg higher at 87.15 stg, on volume of 210 of the total 432 lots.
On barley, active November rose by 0.75 stg to 81.25 stg on volume of 41 of the total 68 lots.

Sterling/mark shed almost four pfennigs to a one-month low, dipping through the psychological 2.90 mark level, on heavy selling of dollar/mark and Bank of England indications that UK rates were steady for now.
